outcome: Maternal complications (incisional infection, breast swelling, unclear dew, abnormal defecation)
Infant complications (breech redness, umbilical cord issues, eczema, delayed umbilical cord detachment)
cohort: 150 primiparous women undergoing cesarean delivery in a hospital in China from January 2021 to January 2022
finding: WeChat-based continuity nursing intervention effectively improved postpartum mental health, reduced complications in both mothers and infants, and enhanced patient satisfaction compared to routine obstetric care.
